what_was_done.action: Wrap wave-bead-mismatch.ts's act() with the dispatch-precondition gate BEFORE the run-coherence-agent fetch (and BEFORE any future label-rollback the FALLBACK block could reinstate)
what_was_done.result: Modified src/lib/reconciler-rules/wave-bead-mismatch.ts. Added imports for buildDispatchContext + evaluatePreconditions + PRECOND_WAVE_BEADS_EXIST from ../dispatch-preconditions and appendEvent + RECONCILER_ACTION_REFUSED from ../event-log. Added a DISPATCH_ACTION constant pinned to 'run-coherence-agent' so the precondition gate, fetch body, and refusal logging share one literal. Added a required repoPath field to WaveBeadMismatchRuleOptions (mirrors marker-driven-routing.ts's pattern). Inside act(), AFTER the snapshot re-read + EscalationContext construction + the existing console.log line, BEFORE the AbortController/fetch sequence, I (a) call buildDispatchContext({ epicId, repoPath, action: DISPATCH_ACTION, waveNumber: ctx.waveNumber }), (b) invoke PRECOND_WAVE_BEADS_EXIST.evaluate(precondCtx) directly — this predicate's appliesTo() returns false for run-coherence-agent in the EXTENDED_PRECONDITION_TABLE because other coherence escalations (stuck-in-stage, repeated-qa-round) target non-wave anomalies, but THIS rule's anomaly IS wave-specific so direct invocation is the right shape — (c) call evaluatePreconditions(precondCtx) for the universal + per-action predicate set registered for run-coherence-agent. On either refusal: structured warn-line tagged `reconciler_dispatch_refused` + appendEvent of type RECONCILER_ACTION_REFUSED to opts.repoPath with payload.ruleName='wave-bead-mismatch' + action='run-coherence-agent' + refusalCode + failedCheck + reason + stage=ctx.wrongStage; early return WITHOUT dispatching AND WITHOUT label mutation. The wave-beads predicate runs FIRST so the niii phantom-wave-4 case (epic at wave:N but listOpenWaveBeads returns []) refuses with NO_WAVE_BEADS before any other predicate or side effect.
what_was_done.evidence: src/lib/reconciler-rules/wave-bead-mismatch.ts lines 41-62 (imports + DISPATCH_ACTION constant + repoPath option), lines 240-318 (precondition gate sequence: buildDispatchContext → PRECOND_WAVE_BEADS_EXIST.evaluate → evaluatePreconditions → conditional refusal handling). The placement matches the bead's risk-flag requirement: 'the precondition check is placed BEFORE the rollback' — current rule has no rollback (post-wlsr.16 cutover commented it out), but if the FALLBACK block were ever uncommented the gate would still be the first side-effect-bearing step.

what_was_done.action: Handle HTTP 412 from the action route as a refusal, not an HTTP failure (architecture § Seam 5 defense-in-depth)
what_was_done.result: Inserted a 412 branch ahead of the existing `if (!res.ok)` error path inside act()'s try block. If res.status === 412, read the body via res.text() (with .catch(() => '<unreadable>')), log a warn-line tagged `reconciler_dispatch_refused_at_route` with epicId/action/httpStatus/body, appendEvent of type RECONCILER_ACTION_REFUSED with payload.refusalCode='ROUTE_REFUSED_412' + failedCheck='route-side-precondition' + reason=<body>, return WITHOUT throwing. Distinguishes route-side precondition refusal (race window between rule check and route check) from a genuine HTTP failure that the existing `if (!res.ok)` throw path handles. Mirrors marker-driven-routing.ts's 412 pattern (ehp.4) verbatim.

surprises_or_findings:
1. The bead description's claim 'Today's rule rolls back labels at line 142 BEFORE checking wave-bead existence' is WRONG vs current code — line 142 is the function-signature line, and the rule has not done label rollback since the wlsr.16 cutover (2026-05-06; the rollback code is preserved as commented-out FALLBACK at lines 280-371 per ADR-015 § 4 step 3). The fix is still load-bearing for the SAME reason though: the current act() dispatches run-coherence-agent unconditionally on a wave-bead-mismatch, which in the niii phantom-wave-4 case (no open wave:4 beads) escalates to coherence pointlessly and pollutes the event log. The precondition gate stops that. AND if the FALLBACK block is ever uncommented (per ADR-010 outcome-attribution gating), the gate's placement BEFORE any side effect ensures the no-side-effect contract is preserved. Per the operator-directive memory `architect-recommendations-involving-literal-grep-patterns-must-be-empirically-verified-against-the-codebase-before-bake-in`, the discrepancy was caught by reading the file, not by trusting the description. Implementation proceeded against the actual code, not against the description's literal claim.

2. PRECOND_WAVE_BEADS_EXIST is registered in EXTENDED_PRECONDITION_TABLE only for actions in ACTIONS_REQUIRING_WAVE_BEADS = {start-wave, review-wave, resume-build}. run-coherence-agent is NOT in that set because other coherence-escalation rules (stuck-in-stage, repeated-qa-round) escalate for non-wave anomalies — adding run-coherence-agent to the set globally would force ALL coherence escalations to wait for open wave beads, which is wrong. The fix is to invoke the predicate DIRECTLY from this rule's act() (in addition to the universal table evaluation) — the rule has rule-specific knowledge that this anomaly IS wave-related. This is a small departure from the marker-driven-routing.ts (ehp.4) pattern where evaluatePreconditions alone is sufficient; documented in the rule file's inline comment block at lines 269-284.

3. The legacy wave-bead-mismatch.test.ts had 15 buildWaveBeadMismatchRule construction sites with mixed indentation (8/10 spaces depending on for-loop nesting). Used two replace_all passes (one per indent level) plus one inline edit for the lone matches()-only construction. Verified all 15 sites carry repoPath via grep. Pre-ehp.6 fetch assertions are byte-identical post-modification because the module-level reader mocks return open BeadSnapshot + null marker + empty labels + a non-empty wave-beads stub — every universal predicate AND the wave-beads predicate pass.

4. Pre-existing test failures in __tests__/api/fleet-action.test.ts (and 2 sibling /api/ test files) returning HTTP 412 instead of 200 are unrelated to ehp.6 — they are introduced by sibling bead ehp.11 (route-side precondition gate at src/app/api/fleet/action/route.ts which is in the working tree but outside ehp.6's modification set). Verified by stash-and-rerun: failing tests fail identically without ehp.6's changes. ehp.11's tests will need to be updated by the ehp.11 bead, not ehp.6.

5. WaveBead's TypeScript type requires { id, title, files } per src/lib/agent-launcher.ts:1290-1302. The test mocks for listOpenWaveBeads pass { id, title: '<stub>', files: [] } objects to satisfy the type — buildDispatchContext only consumes .id (line 1394 of dispatch-preconditions.ts) so the stub values are inert at runtime.
